$comment: Live evidence for 'Proof, not promises' and the live receipt. Fill txHash after each live run on Cardano preprod (64 hex characters, copied from the explorer) and 'at' (UTC, from the explorer). Never invent one: an empty or malformed hash renders as 'Awaiting live run'. 'receipt' is the live escrow run the receipt shows: the lock and result entries it links to, plus values read from those two transactions (the result hash is the escrow datum's result_hash after SubmitResult).
